familia.hero_text: Discover Peru through experiences designed to enjoy as a family: adventure, comfort and moments you'll always remember.
familia.who_title: Who's coming on your family adventure?
familia.who_hint: Choose as many as you like.
familia.who_filtering: Showing tours for the people traveling
familia.tours_text: From the magic of Cusco to Peru's most breathtaking landscapes. Choose experiences that fit your family's ages and pace.
familia.tours_empty_title: We're creating new experiences for your family.
familia.tours_empty_text: Tell us where you'd like to go and who's coming. We'll design an experience around your family.
familia.gen_text: We take care of the details that make a difference when you travel together, so all you have to do is enjoy.
familia.gen_kids_text: Itineraries with breaks, unhurried meals and time to rest. Because a great family trip isn't measured by how much you fit in.
familia.gen_teens_text: Every tour shows the minimum age and who it's ideal for. You'll know from the start if it's right for your family.
familia.gen_parents_text: We coordinate tickets, trains and transfers, and clearly explain prices and what's included. You just enjoy.
familia.gen_grandparents_lead: Experiences grown-ups and kids enjoy alike.
familia.gen_grandparents_text: Activities, stories and landscapes you live together and remember for years. Peru, told for the whole family.
familia.moments_text: Smiles, discoveries and shared moments from families who've already explored Peru with us.
familia.moments_alt: Family traveling with Like In House, photo {n}
familia.catalog_text: Choose who's traveling and we'll show the tours that best suit your family. Each one lists its recommended ages and pace.
familia.about_eyebrow: Get to know Like In House Familia
familia.about_intro_1: We're a Peruvian travel agency founded in 2018. With Like In House Familia, we design trips so the whole family can enjoy Peru together, with the pace and comfort it needs.
familia.about_story_title: Every family is different. Their journey should be, too.
familia.about_story_1: We know family travel is different: schedules shift, everyone gets tired at some point and each person enjoys things their own way. That's why we care about pace, activities and time to rest.
familia.about_story_2: It's not about doing more, but about enjoying every experience better, together. We're with you from the first question until you're back home.
familia.about_value_1_text: We listen, answer your questions and guide you while you plan your family's trip.
familia.about_value_2_text: Prices, recommended ages and included services explained before you book, with no surprises.
familia.about_value_3_text: We work with local providers and communities, and follow the ESNNA child protection code.
familia.faq_page_title_1: Everything you need to know about
familia.faq_page_title_2: traveling to Peru as a family.
familia.faq_page_text_1: The questions families ask us most before traveling. If yours isn't here, message us and we'll get back to you.
familia.faq_general_note: We'll soon add family-specific questions. Meanwhile, these are the ones all our travelers ask.
familia.contact_text: Tell us where you'd like to go, when, and who's coming. Our team will help you find the right experience for your family.
familia.contact_form_title: Tell us about your family trip.
familia.contact_form_text: Include approximate dates, destinations and the ages of everyone traveling. If anyone needs a more relaxed pace, let us know.
familia.contact_whatsapp_text: Ask our team about destinations, recommended ages and availability, right away.
